summary.text: Katie Hobbs is the Democratic incumbent Governor of Arizona, seeking a second term with running mate John Giles, the former mayor of Mesa. A social worker by training, she served in the Arizona House and Senate and as Secretary of State before being elected governor in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Born in Phoenix and raised in Tempe; earned a bachelor's degree in social work from Northern Arizona University (1992) and a master's in social work from Arizona State University (1995).
Worked as a social worker and as chief compliance officer at the Sojourner Center, a domestic violence shelter; executive director of Emerge Arizona from 2013 to 2019.
Served one term in the Arizona House (elected 2010) and three terms in the Arizona Senate (elected 2012, 2014, 2016), including as Senate Minority Leader beginning in 2015.
Served as Arizona Secretary of State from January 2019 until she became governor in January 2023.
